physics_rules.name: Linear Regulator Dissipation
physics_rules.mitigation: Switch to buck regulator if Pd > 1.5W without large heatsink

common_thermal_failures.symptom: Output voltage drops under load; component hot to touch (>80°C)
common_thermal_failures.root_cause: Excessive (Vin - Vout) differential causing internal thermal shutdown
common_thermal_failures.fix: Lower input voltage or replace with pin-compatible switching regulator

common_thermal_failures.symptom: Drain-Source short circuit; smoke on turn-on
common_thermal_failures.root_cause: Insufficient gate drive voltage (Vgs) leading to operation in linear ohmic region instead of full saturation
common_thermal_failures.fix: Use logic-level gate MOSFET (e.g., IRLZ44N) or dedicated gate driver IC
